migration_runner_recipe:
"""Frozen real-API diagnostic on a mutable retained copy, not an acceptance run."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--source',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--phase',choices=['before','after'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output',required=True)
args=parser.parse_args()
sys.path.insert(0,args.source)
from commontrace import fact_store as fs,hierarchical as h
from benchmarks.next_generation_storage import items,statement
assert all(str(Path(module.__file__).resolve()).startswith(args.source+'/') for module in (fs,h))
root=Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-root').read_text().strip()
next_path=Path('/tmp/commontrace-p0-million-tuning-next-index')
start=int(next_path.read_text())
path=fs.database_path(root)
def counts(connection):
 return {name:connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM '+name).fetchone()[0] for name in ('facts','events','lexicon','postings')}
def checksums(connection):
 result={}
 for label,sql in [('events','SELECT seq,fact_id,version,operation,record FROM events ORDER BY seq'),('payloads','SELECT id,payload FROM facts ORDER BY id')]:
  digest=hashlib.sha256()
  for row in connection.execute(sql):
   digest.update(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode());digest.update(b'\n')
  result[label]=digest.hexdigest()
 return result
report={'phase':args.phase,'scope':'Frozen runtime on existing mutable million-copy, concurrent full suite elsewhere. Non-randomized timings, warmed by checksum reads; not release acceptance evidence.','source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=args.source,text=True).strip(),'source_root':args.source,'source_files_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256((Path(args.source)/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=args.source).decode().split('\0') if name and (Path(args.source)/name).is_file()},'python':sys.version,'root':root,'command':sys.argv,'batches':[]}
with sqlite3.connect(path) as raw:
 report['before']=counts(raw)
 if args.phase=='after':report['authoritative_before']=checksums(raw)
print(json.dumps({'phase':args.phase,'before':report['before']}),flush=True)
started=time.perf_counter()
with fs.transaction(root) as facts:
 report['open_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-started
 report['after_open']=counts(facts.connection)
 if args.phase=='after':
  report['authoritative_after']=checksums(facts.connection)
  assert report['authoritative_before']==report['authoritative_after']
  assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='near_postings'").fetchone()==('global-v2',)
  assert facts.connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM lexicon l WHERE l.documents!=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM postings p WHERE p.term_id=l.id) LIMIT 1").fetchone() is None
  report['document_frequencies_exact']=True
 samples=[]
 for n in range(20):
  query='its event journal uses durable storage for component item'+str(n)
  t=time.perf_counter();found=fs.StatementIndex(facts).near(query,[]);samples.append((time.perf_counter()-t)*1000)
  assert found is not None and found.statement==statement(n)
 report['near_lookup_samples_ms']=samples
 report['near_lookup_p95_ms']=sorted(samples)[math.ceil(len(samples)*.95)-1]
print(json.dumps({key:report[key] for key in ('open_seconds','after_open','near_lookup_p95_ms')}),flush=True)
for _ in range(2):
 t=time.perf_counter();result=h.add_facts(root,items(start,1000));elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
 assert len(result)==1000 and all(action=='ADD' for _,action in result)
 report['batches'].append({'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'facts_per_second':1000/elapsed,'start':start})
 start+=1000;next_path.write_text(str(start))
 print(json.dumps(report['batches'][-1]),flush=True)
with fs.transaction(root) as facts:report['after_batches']=counts(facts.connection)
fs.close_connections(root)
report['runner_source']=Path(__file__).read_text()
Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
